description: Add a bankruptcy case to your BankruptcyObserver.com monitoring list so BKO checks the court hourly and updates the docket every business day. Pass simple_name or a 7-digit case_number (with court when the number is reused). Subscribers only; respects your plan monitoring limit.

case_number.description: 7-digit short case number alternative to simple_name.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.

name: add_monitored_case_tool
